note: Codes: expected_code is what the case was built to show; native_code is lc_verify_v3's program logic (lc_v3::handle) on the same message and job state, then attest's rules for a chained Apply. lc_verify_v3 refuses by exit code (charged the cycles used); attest.Apply refuses by panic, and a timestamp-window miss is charged the whole declared gas. declared_gas is 10,000,000 here (the refusal tool); attest_host::submit_update_staged declares 9,000,000 for Begin, 7,000,000 for Miller and 5,500,000 for Finish.
